description_en: A one-click cross-platform product material optimization service for cross-border e-commerce sellers (minimum cost version). Input product links from source platforms to generate optimized materials including titles, attributes, main images, SKU images, detail images, and descriptions that comply with the target platform's requirements. Uses officially pre-built minimum-cost workflows, primarily based on filtering and lightweight processing without invoking high-cost image translation capabilities, maximizing cost control while ensuring listing compliance. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 面向跨境电商卖家的跨平台商品素材一键优化服务（最低成本版）。输入货源平台商品链接，一键输出适配铺货平台要求的标题、属性、主图、SKU图、详情图与文案等全量素材。采用官方预制的最低成本流程，以过滤+轻量处理为主，不调用高成本的图片翻译能力，在保证上架合规性的前提下最大限度控制调用成本。（异步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge asset-optimize-lite --product-url https://detail.1688.com/offer/631960323816.html --source-platform 1688 --target-platform temu --source-language zh --target-language en --need-trans true --including-product-area false --translating-brand-in-the-product false --glossary '测试' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssetOptimizeLite
